meta_description:
149 likes, 0 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 22, 2026: "We often wait for someone or something outside us to make us feel better. But true upliftment begins from within.

Through our thoughts, choices and daily actions, we have the ability to change the way we experience life. Instead of constantly looking outward, pause and ask yourself: What can I do today to lift my own mind and spirit?

The first step towards a better state of mind begins with you.".
